name: Logistics Dispatcher
description: Practical explanation of delivery times, sorting routes, and fuel allowance calculations

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How do you calculate delivery allowances?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Fuel rate per kilometer is in cell $A$1. For trip distance in B2, the allowance is =B2*$A$1. Because $A$1 is absolute, copying it down to row 50 maintains the same fuel rate.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How do you check for overtime trips?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I use =IF(C2>8,"Overtime","Standard"). If driving hours in C2 exceed 8, it flags Overtime. I also use =SUM(D2:D50) to get the total daily allowance.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How do you organize the route sheets and charts?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Each dispatch day has its own worksheet tab in the workbook. In the dispatch table, I sort by delivery priority. I select data and make a chart comparing trips by zone with a title.
